startup_idea: “An AI-powered platform for college students that analyzes their skills, interests, academic background, and career goals to recommend personalized internship opportunities. The platform uses AI to match students with suitable internships, identifies missing skills, recommends learning resources, and provides companies with ranked candidates based on job requirements. The business will use a freemium model for students and a subscription/recruitment fee for companies, initially targeting students and startups in India.

idea_analysis.problem: College students struggle to find internships that match their skills and career goals.
idea_analysis.proposed_solution: An AI platform that analyzes student profiles and recommends personalized internships, identifies skill gaps, and offers learning resources.
idea_analysis.target_customer: College students and startup companies in India
idea_analysis.business_model: Freemium for students and subscription or recruitment fee for companies
idea_analysis.key_value_proposition: Provides tailored internship matches and skill development guidance for students while giving companies ranked candidate lists
assumptions: Students have access to digital devices and internet.
Startups are willing to pay for candidate ranking.
AI can accurately match skills to internship requirements.
